description.value: Gary's Bistro has been a Qualicum Beach landmark since 1993, celebrated for its distinctive hot-rod-themed décor featuring a vintage car mounted on the wall. The menu spans hearty breakfasts, lunches, and dinners with homestyle comfort food including house-made clam chowder and Eggs Benedict variations. An outdoor patio and warm small-town atmosphere make it a natural gathering spot for travellers passing through central Vancouver Island.

address.value: 115 Second Avenue West, Qualicum Beach, V9K 1S7

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM record: phone (250) 752-5800, address 115 West Second Ave Qualicum Beach, and the restaurant has been operating since 1993. The menu page confirms a Veggie Benny and salad options indicating vegetarian dishes. No explicit mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, takeout, or Wi-Fi was found on the website, so those remain null. One minor discrepancy: the contact subpage lists 'Qualicum Bay, BC' instead of 'Qualicum Beach, BC', which appears to be a website typo since every other page reference uses 'Qualicum Beach'.
concerns: Website contact subpage lists city as 'Qualicum Bay, BC' rather than 'Qualicum Beach, BC'; all other pages use the correct 'Qualicum Beach', suggesting a typo rather than a genuine address discrepancy.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, actively operating full-service restaurant in central Qualicum Beach confirmed open as recently as April 2026, with a welcoming atmosphere, patio seating, and a diverse menu — a natural resupply stop for touring cyclists on Vancouver Island.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists a dedicated Veggie Benny (tomato, sautéed spinach and onions with homemade hash) and a house salad with optional add-ons; taco salad and other plant-forward items also available
